column1: # Cartridges whose shell isn't their system's usual one (src/cartridge.py): fit-cartridge leaves their photos out.
# Per game: its code, the system and the game's three letters, for every region (DMG-VPH: DMG-VPHJ-JPN, DMG-VPHE-USA...),
# or a whole serial where a game's don't follow that; what is special about the shell; the title. The Rumble Pak games
# are those whose four-letter code starts with V: all 22 Wikipedia lists ("Cartridge feature", List of Game Boy Color
# games), and CGB-VVJ, which it doesn't. The Game Boy Advance ones (taller shells, with a sensor or a rumble motor):
# the Boktai games (a solar sensor), the tilt and gyro sensor games, and Drill Dozer (rumble).
